title: Gumloop pricing: Is it worth it?
summary: Gumloop pricing uses a credit system that can be confusing for new users. We break down the cost and what hidden fees to watch out for before you build.
body_markdown:
**Gumloop**


**Zapier**


**Pricing model**


Credit-based (14-day Pro trial, no free plan)


Task-based (free tier available)


**How costs are calculated**


Varies by model usage, tool calls (1+ credit each), compute time, and an 8% orchestration fee


Fixed cost per completed task (1 task for standard actions, 3 or 5 tasks for advanced or premium AI models)


**Cost predictability**


Less predictable—depends on how workflows run


More predictable—easier to estimate monthly usage


**Complex AI workflows**


Can get expensive quickly (more credits per run)


Still predictable (tasks per action)


**Scaling across teams**


Requires active credit monitoring


Easier to budget as usage grows


**Best for**


AI-only workflows


Consistent, scalable automation with AI built in
